The terms used in descriptive bibliography to designate the Format (shapes) of books often cause more confusion than clarity. Terms such as folio, quarto (4to), octavo (8vo), etc. were coined based on the printing practices developed in the pre-1800 hand-press period, and continued to be used (albeit often inexactly) after the introduction of machine-printing.
